blocks.html: Mactan City, Cebu - Before the year ends, RLC Residences achieved another construction milestone as it held a groundbreaking ceremony for the fourth tower of AmiSa Private Residences.

Present during the event were RLC Residences Vice President for Project Management Engr. Emmanuel Arce, RLC Residences Cebu Branch Head Gretchen Marie Lim- Belleza, RLC Residences Cluster Head Melissa Magno, and RLC Residences Cebu Sales Directors Federico Pandagani, Leoniza Aguitong, Eugene Arcena, and Dennis Siongco.

“We are very excited to start bringing to life the fourth tower of AmiSa Private Residences. This development has a very special place to our hearts given its unique features and resort-like offerings. We believe our clients are also excited to call this haven their own where they can enjoy a relaxing life in Cebu,” said RLC Residences VP for Project Management Engr. Emmanuel Arce.

Located at Punta Engano in Mactan City, Cebu, AmiSa Private Residences is a leisure residential development by RLC Residences that offers relaxing, unobstructed beach views that can be enjoyed from the unit’s balcony. The first three towers of this development are now finished and are being enjoyed by its residents, while the pre-seling fourth tower was introduced in 2022.
To know more about AmiSa Private Residences and other RLC Residences projects in Manila and Cebu, visit rlcresidences.com or follow them on Facebook and Instagram.
